apps.localizedDescription:
Coffee Inc 2+ : The Complete Coffee Empire Experience

Coffee Inc 2+ is the Apple Arcade edition of the hit business simulation game. Build your coffee empire across the world — without limits. Every feature, upgrade, and expansion is fully unlocked, with no in-app purchases required.

Start as the founder of a single cafe and grow into a global powerhouse. Craft new products, inspire employees, expand into major cities, and dominate the market. Every decision is yours.

---------------------------
Highlights in Coffee Inc 2+

• Expand into real-world cities: San Francisco, Chicago, New York, Tokyo, Osaka, London, Paris, Berlin, Amsterdam, Rome, Madrid, Sydney, and Seattle.
• Play globally with multiple currencies: USD, EUR, JPY,
